background_notes.fact: For the R-module L=iota(M_R), the image E_ii(L)=J e_i is finitely generated: L has a finite generating family because M_R is free of finite rank n and iota is an R-linear isomorphism onto L. Moreover c↦c e_i is an R-linear isomorphism J→J e_i, so J is finitely generated.

grounds.reason: M_R is free of finite rank n and iota embeds it in V.
F001 identifies E_ii(L) with J e_i.
Each e_i is a nonzero vector of a complex basis.
0≤λ gives 0∈I, so an index i can be taken, including when λ=0.

background_notes.justification: Choose a finite basis b_1,…,b_n of M_R from its finite freeness. Their images generate L. By R-linearity, E_ii(∑ r_a iota(b_a))=∑ r_a E_ii(iota(b_a)), so these finitely many projected images generate J e_i. Scalar multiplication J→J e_i is surjective by the definition of J e_i and injective since e_i≠0 in a complex vector space. Transporting the projected generators through its inverse yields a finite generating family of J.
